tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang gi phyag len 'gro shes bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i sku/ /legs sbyar 'chi med rnga chen phyogs brgyar sgrog /gang thugs bde chen 'phel ba'i rdo rje 'chang / /skyabs mchog bla mas bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod nas rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa bzhin bri bar bya ste/ de yang mgon dkar la gtor ma zan dras zlum po'i steng du nor bu mig gsum pa de'i steng du dzaṃ bshos kyi dbyibs lta bu la rtse rgyan dar dkar gyi gur dang ldan pa/ stegs bu ji ltar 'os pa'i steng du bzhag de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod lnga bsham/ spro na 'bul gtor gnyis kyang bshams te/ slob dpon stan bde ba la 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ rang gi snying gar thig le dmar po rgya sran tsam pa de'i dkyil du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs ma'i mdog lta bu gcig bsgom/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus de gnyis la thim/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang thig le ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug 'phyar ba/ gnyis pas nor bu/ gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa dang / bum pa rin chen sna tshogs kyis bkang ba brla g.yon la brten te 'dzin pa/ bar pa rtse gsum/ mtha' ma lcags kyu snom pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sku smad rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang byon pa 'dra ba 'gro 'phro la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i zhabs 'og na tshogs bdag re re gnas te/ kha dang bshang lam nas rin po che lhug lhug yong ba 'dra ba/

mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa gcig bsgom/ mgon po'i thugs khar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon thod pa/ zhabs gar stabs/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ge gzigs pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa gcig bskyed/ snying gar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba gcig gsal btab/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hos rang la bstim/ gu ru mahā ka la ha ri ni sa sidhi dza zhes bsnyen sngags bzla/ de nas mdun gyi gtor ma bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las mgon dkar du bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ gu ru mahā kā la sa pā ri wa ras sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ 'bul gtor yang 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ gu ru mahā kā la sa pā ri wa re i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul/ de nas slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu/ slob dpon la maṇḍal dbul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs kyi rgyun bshags lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi sku las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams bcom ldan yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa nas thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin bskyed/ de nas dngos gzhi la slob dpon dang mdun gyi gtor ma mgon dkar du gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i mgon po'i thugs khar phog bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig rjes su dran pa'i dbang gis mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig thang gcig yud tsam la mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir byon/

de las de 'dra ba'i sku dpag tu med pa mched/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos par mdzod byas la/ rol chen bya zhing gu gul gyi dud pas bdug gu ru mahā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dza/ a bhya sha ya a/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lnga brjod/ de ni sku'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang zhu ba'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon la mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud gnang bas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa yi ge ā li kā li dang khyad par ye shes mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad chos skyong spyi'i sngags sha sa na dang / mgon dkar 'di nyid kyi sngags gu ru mahā kā la sogs kyi sngags 'phreng kha dog dkar po rang sgra sgrog bzhin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang bar 'ur 'ur thib thib byung nas khyed rang mgon dkar du gsal ba'i mgrin pa nas thim/ gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rol chen dang / spos dud/ gu ru mahā kā la sogs kyi sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ de ni gsung gi rjes su gnang ba yin/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du yang thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon la gus 'dud gnang bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus pa thams cad rnam pa gri gug dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang ḍā ma ru dang thod pa'i 'phreng ba la sogs pa phyag mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba 'ur 'ur thib thib byung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas pa la sems 'tsher ba gcig gtad pas/ de rnams 'od dang 'od zer gyis rnam par zhu nas/

khyed rang mgon dkar du gsal ba'i snying ga nas thim pas/ thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rol chen dang spos dud bya zhing / sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ de ni thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba yin/ yang thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon mgon dkar du gsal ba dang / /mdun bskyed kyi mgon po gnyis kyi spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams su dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon thod pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ge gzigs pa re lamaste gsal btab pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i sku las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi zas nor bcud dbyangs la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas/ khyed rang la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rol chen dang spos dud/ sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ de nas bzlas lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i sngags 'phreng las/ sngags 'phreng dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum rnams mched pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ gu ru mahā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥ zhes pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du phyag gi me tog 'thor ba re gnang la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum de ltar phul bas me tog de sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi dbu gtsug tu phul bas sngags kyi dngos grub dus myur du thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ slob ma'i mgo la me tog 'thor zhing / bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/

/brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i sku gsung thugs gsang sngags rigs sngags kyi nus mthu dang byin rlabs thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig de nas gtor ma mgon dkar du gsal ba slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag la/ gu ru mahā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥ sa ma ya smra/ sa ma ya ma ti pra ma tha/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ rdo rje 'chang / dpal sha wa ri/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ grub thob rā hu la gupta badzra/ grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dben ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ mang mkhar ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bu rong pa dpal ldan dar po/ zhe dgon pa rje bsod nams rtse mo/ skal bzang 'gyur med/ bde chen rtsa ba'i bla ma ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ rdo rje'i slob ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la bsgo zhing 'ches pa dang / bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams la sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su 'tsho ba'i yo byad thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / tshe dang bsod nams lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ khyed rang gi spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i mgon dkar 'od du bstims zhu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hos gnyis su med par thim pas/ mgon po lus dang grib ma ltar du 'grogs te/ srung skyob mdzad pa yin snyam pa'i thugs mos gnang ba zhu/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar dang / maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te rnams spyi dang 'dra/

'bul gtor steng du dbul/ yig brgya lan gsum/ nongs pa bzod gsol/ dge rtsa sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni lo chen dam pa 'gyur med bde chen gyis ji ltar mdzad pa'i phyag len rnams yid yul du nges par byas pa'i zin bris kyi tho chung la brten nas/ slar sa pho rta lo chos sgo thar gling gi gtsug lag khang du lo chen de nyid kyi zhabs pad nye bar bsten pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis legs par bkod pa'o// //dge legs 'phel// //sarba maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 ngag dbang chos grags/ mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang gi phyag len/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
